title: ExecutionKey (Action Clearance prerequisites)
description: Design artifact, NOT a committed runtime contract. Canonical one-time execution reservation key. Stable across retries, unique across distinct authorized actions. Maps onto ugence_decision_authority execution_idempotency_key.

authorized_action_fingerprint.description: SHA over the exact action identity; folds in merge_method and profile.

x-carried-not-in-key.profile_id: implied by authorized_action_fingerprint; audit metadata only
x-carried-not-in-key.clearance_receipt_ref: validated at reservation time, NOT part of key identity (a re-issued receipt must not mint a new key)

x-serialization: canonical, domain-separated SHA-256 -> exec_key.v1:<sha256hex>; becomes execution_idempotency_key in the ledger
